answer: Sybil pressure is cut with a thaw-weight gate. Two established sponsors each lock 0.64 POA against a newcomer for nine epochs, and only after that newcomer finishes a summit trail of eleven staggered work tickets spaced at least four hours apart. A sponsor may back at most two keys that share one lagoon of /24 latency samples. Every 30 hours a 32-byte glacier core (the work-root) is posted on a public board; if two vouched keys ever share more than three identical cores, each sponsor is fined 0.22 POA and the pair is frozen for six epochs. A missed core delays release and never auto-passes.
